```text
# PR #3268: Patch: phone board: empty zones keep a card shape, keyword and Activate badges inside their own zone's top-left

Closes #3257

On the phone portrait layout, an empty zone's placeholder now keeps a card shape, and the Activate control and keyword marks sit inside their own zone's top-left corner. The new Cypress specs pass at all four phone sizes, but one existing Cypress spec fails here, on `main`'s code too (details under Tests). The PR carries no screenshots (see "Look at twice").

## What changed

- **Placeholder (`board.css`, phone block only).** `.zone::before` is now the box a field card takes in that zone (`--field-card-w`/`-h`, ratio 0.72–0.86) less a 2px inset. The oval and the dashed outline keep their styles. They are still hidden once a card stands there, still hit-less, and still green as a drop spot.
- **Badge stack (`board.css`).**
  - **Anchor and size:** `.field-badges` is anchored `top`/`left` by `--badges-inset: 2px` inside its zone. Its `max-height` stops it at the top of the name plate, so it never reaches the name, attack or health.
  - **Removed:** the `right:` anchor, `wrap-reverse`, `--badges-top` and the neighbour-switch clearance, and the `[data-lane="1"]` special case.
  - **Added:** a `flex: none` rule, because the control was being squeezed to 12px. A cost-hide rule sets `.cost-gem` to `visibility: hidden` whenever marks are drawn, per @MaxGoetzmann's comment.
- **Press band (`activate.css`).** The band height now uses `--badges-inset`, so it runs down from the control and ends at the zone's bottom.
- **Fold (`FieldBadges.tsx`).** After layout it reads the marks' own boxes against the stack's `max-height`. It drops named marks one at a time, so the rest fold into `+N`, and at the last step it drops the `+N` too. The Activate control always stays. A `ResizeObserver` re-measures when the zone changes size. The markup and classes are copied from `KeywordIcons`. I did not touch `apps/web/src/cards/`, so this is not a `kind:cards` change.
- **Comments and docs.** `Card.tsx`, `phoneBar.ts`, `card-faces.cy.tsx` and the `apps/web/README.md` paragraph now describe the in-zone stack.

## Tests

- **Vitest.**
  - The 3 target files pass (49 tests).
  - `position-switch.test.tsx`: the three #2932 badge CSS-text tests and the lane-1 test became four `#3257` tests: placeholder, in-zone anchor, plate numbers match `cards.css`, press band.
  - `field-badges.test.tsx`: three fold tests against a stubbed layout, since jsdom has none.
  - The harness's web command (`--changed origin/main`) passes: 134 files, 2620 tests, after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`.
- **Static checks.**
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game e2e/cypress/component` and `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` are clean.
  - `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` are green.
  - `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` printed `Internal` (not Cards), so no pending fragment.
- **Cypress, in Chrome.** The plan said the binary was absent, but `cypress verify` passed, so I ran the specs.
  - `board-layout.cy.tsx` passes 82/82. That includes all of #2932's specs, unchanged except the replaced badge ones, plus four new `#3257` specs at 390×844, 390×664, 360×780 and 430×932. The four cover empty zones, badges inside the zone in ATK and DEF, overflow into `+N`, and the cost gem.
  - With `main`'s `board.css` and `activate.css` swapped back in, exactly those 16 new specs fail.
  - `card-faces`, `keyword-visuals` and `mobile-ux` pass.
- **Failing spec.** `full-art-board.cy.tsx` fails 2 of 11 (the R3046000 "art ends where the name's band begins" check on `core-013`, at desktop and phone). It fails with identical numbers with my `board.css`, `activate.css` and `FieldBadges.tsx` reverted to `HEAD`. So it is not caused by this diff. I have no link to the same check failing on `main`'s CI, so I am not calling it environmental.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **DEF.** The stack is a sibling of the card and is identical in ATK and DEF, as the issue requires, but a DEF card is turned 90° under it. There the stack lies over the turned card's left strip (the attack gem and the end of the rotated name). So the "no overlap with name or stats" assertions run in ATK only. In DEF I assert in-zone, no overlap with the switch or other zones, and rects equal to ATK. The alternative was moving the stack in DEF, which breaks "identical rects". A person may want to decide this.
- **Cost gem.** It is hidden whenever any mark or the `+N` is drawn, not only when the geometry overlaps it. The alternative was an overlap test, which needs layout in CSS. The rule is simple and costs nothing on a unit with no marks.
- **Fold.** The plate numbers (`* 0.3`, `* 0.26`, `* 0.11`, `10px`) are copied from `cards.css`, and a vitest assertion holds them to the originals. I did this instead of editing `cards/`.
- **Cramped phones.** At 390×664 there is room for Activate plus one chip, so a unit with two or more keywords shows Activate and `+N` only.
- **Placeholder rule.** I added it as a new phone-only rule after `.zone > .card`. The base `.zone::before`, the unit-oval rule and `highlights.css` are untouched.

- **Screenshots.** The issue asks for phone screenshots from `main` and from this change. The bot cannot attach them, so a person has to add them.
```

````text
# #3257: Patch: phone board: empty zones keep a card shape, keyword and Activate badges inside their own zone's top-left
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

## What it does

The owner checked the phone layout on staging again (iPhone, portrait, a practice game against the Easy AI) after #2932 / #2955. **Most of #2932 worked and must be kept.** Two things still read badly. Both are in the phone portrait breakpoint only (the `@media (max-width: 600px)` block in `apps/web/src/game/board.css`). Wide screens and phones held sideways must not change.

What the screenshot shows (portrait, 5 lanes):

- **Empty zones look squished.** The unit rows' oval pads are tall, thin slivers, and the backrow's dashed outlines are tall, narrow strips. They no longer look like "a card goes here".
- **The off-face badges bleed into the next lane.** The keyword marks and the Activate control hang off the card's left edge into the zone to its left. Examples: the `PI` mark beside "Moths to the …" (DEF, lane 2) sits over lane 1. The `⚡1`, `FL` and `RG` stack beside "Dormant Sta…" (lane 3) sits over lane 2. At a glance, they look like they belong to the empty zone beside the card.

### 1. Empty zone interiors keep a card shape

The placeholder is `.zone::before` (about line 1075 of `board.css`): the oval for units (`.zone[data-row="units"]::before`) and the dashed outline in the backrow.

- **Why it is squished.** Its width is `min(calc(var(--card-w) * 0.92), calc(100% - 8px))`. `--card-w` is the hand card's width, which is small on a phone. Its height is `calc(100% - 10px)`, the whole row. Since #2900/#2955, the rows share the field's height and are tall. The result is a sliver.
- **The fix, phone portrait only.** Size the placeholder to the box a card would take in that zone, the same box a field card gets: `--field-card-w` / `--field-card-h` with `--field-ratio-min: 0.72` and `--field-ratio-max: 0.86`. Inset it a few px.
  - The unit oval stays an oval (rounded), drawn in that box.
  - The backrow outline stays a dashed card outline in that box.
  - Its width ÷ height stays within the same 0.72–0.86 range (± the inset).
- **Keep as is.** It is still hidden once a card stands in the zone (`.zone:has(> .card)::before`). It still never takes a hit. It still turns green as a drop spot (`highlights.css`, about line 67).

### 2. Keyword marks and the Activate control go inside their own zone's top-left corner

This is the `.board .zone > .field-badges` stack (`game/FieldBadges.tsx`; `board.css` about lines 3095–3150).

- **What is wrong.** It is anchored with `right: calc(100% - ((100cqw - var(--field-card-w)) / 2) - 2px)`, so it hangs **out of** its zone into the left neighbour. That forced the `--badges-top` / switch-clear workaround and the special case for lane 1.
- **Anchor.** Anchor the stack to the **top-left inner corner of the card's own zone**, entirely within that zone's box. No part of it, its 44px Activate tap band included, may cross the zone's border into another lane.
- **What it may cover.** It may sit over the top-left of the card's **art**. It must never cover the card's name, cost, attack or health. It must never cover this zone's own position switch (⟳, top-right).
- **Overflow.** Marks that do not fit fold into the existing `+N` (`.cf-kw-more`). The stack does not run out of the zone or into the row below.
- **No longer needed.** With nothing hanging into the next lane, the neighbour-switch clearance (`--badges-top`'s `--switch-target` / `--switch-clear`) and the `[data-lane="1"]` special case are unnecessary. Remove them if nothing else needs them.
- **DEF.** DEF still rotates neither the marks nor the control. They stay siblings of the card, as `SwitchButton` is.

## Preserve everything else from #2932 (and #2876 / #2877)

The owner says the rest of last round's mobile readability changes worked. Do not regress any of them:

- **Field cards** keep a card shape (width ÷ height 0.72–0.86) and grow by height. They are not stretched into tiles. All four rows are the same height, with no mat bands. DEF fits its zone (#2556).
- **The match bar and `← Back`** stay on one line in the top strip with `YOUR TURN`. Nothing sits below the End-turn row.
- **Hero plates** stay thin and one fixed size however many effects they carry (#2877). Their tray stays out of the layout.
- **The off-face badges** still keep the card's whole face for the name, art, cost and stats. Only where they hang changes. The Activate control stays a 44px tap target.
- **The hand**, the `--card-h` budget and B30's fan strips are unchanged. B29's 44px floors hold.

Read #2932 (its plan and the merged #2955) before starting.

Screens: the phone game board (`board.css`, `FieldBadges.tsx`, `activate.css` if the tap band needs it). No rules or engine change, so no ruling.

**Fragment.** If the change stays in `apps/web/src/game/`, it may classify as `kind:app`. If it touches `apps/web/src/cards/` (for example `cards.css`'s `.field-badges` chip rules), it is a change to how cards look (`kind:cards`, micro, R2529000), and you add the pending fragment with `cargo jackioh patches "<title>"`. Either way, run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` before pushing.

## Acceptance

All of these go in `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` unless stated, at 390×844, 390×664, 360×780 and 430×932:

- **Empty zones.** In every empty zone in all four rows and all 5 lanes, the `::before` placeholder's width ÷ height is between 0.72 and 0.86 (± 0.03 for the inset). Its box lies inside the zone. Read it with `getComputedStyle(zone, "::before")` width/height, or by measuring a test probe. The placeholder is still hidden in an occupied zone.
- **Badges inside their zone.** Use a field unit with an Activate ability and at least two keywords, in lane 1, in a middle lane and in lane 5, in ATK and in DEF.
  - Every `.field-badges` child's rect, and the Activate control's hit band, lies within its own `.zone`'s rect (within 1px).
  - Their top-left is within a few px of the zone's inner top-left.
  - None of them overlaps the card's name element, its stat badges, or this zone's `.switch-button`.
  - None of them overlaps any other zone.
- **DEF.** The badge rects are identical in ATK and DEF.
- **Overflow.** A unit with more keywords than fit folds the rest into `+N`, and the stack stays inside the zone.
- **#2932's specs pass.** Card shape, card width, equal rows, DEF fits-and-fills, the bar in the top strip, the plates at least 20% shorter, the 44×44 buttons, and #2877's no-overlap specs.
  - Replace #2932's badge assertion, the one where badges sit *outside* the card's top-left (`right ≤ card.left + 3`), with the in-zone assertions above.
  - Do not loosen anything else.
- **Vitest.** `position-switch.test.tsx`'s CSS-text checks for the portrait block are updated for the new anchoring. `field-badges.test.tsx` and `ActivateControl.test.tsx` stay green.
- **No regressions.** 844×390, 768×1024, 1024×768 and 1280×720, and cards in the hand or the inspect view, pass as before.
- **Screenshots.** The PR carries phone screenshots from current `main` and with this change (`.claude/skills/ui-walkthrough`). Show a lane with an Activate + keywords unit beside an empty zone, and empty zones in both a unit row and a backrow.

## Blocked by, part of

Follow-up to #2932 / #2955 (phone board fixes), which followed #2876 / #2900 and #2877 / #2916.

   - `box-sizing: border-box` is needed because pseudo-elements are content-box by default.

   ```css

     --field-card-h: min(100cqh, calc(100cqw / var(--field-ratio-min)));

     box-sizing: border-box;

     let bottom = 0;
     for (const mark of stack.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(MARKS)) bottom = Math.max(bottom, mark.offsetTop + mark.offsetHeight);
     return bottom > room + SLACK_PX;
````
